summary: Raytech Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, announcing it will change its English name to Atlas Trinity Tech Limited and its Nasdaq ticker from RAY to ATTT, effective around September 10, 2026. The change is part of the company's strategic development plan and requires no shareholder approval or transaction. No financial terms, advisors, or deal mechanics are involved. The filing is a routine corporate identity update, not a special-situation event. What to watch: confirmation of the effective date and continued Nasdaq listing under the new ticker.
